claims.answer: Desktop app for macOS 12+ (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows 10 1809+/11 (x64, arm64) and Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+ x86_64, 24.04+ aarch64 AppImage, X11 or XWayland); Windows and Linux builds are previews. iPhone companion through TestFlight beta, Android from source only. evidence.title: Desktop platform support
evidence.locator: Target table, Native runtimes and dependencies
evidence.finding: Six release targets (macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64/arm64, Linux x86_64/aarch64 AppImage); Windows and Linux are previews with incomplete interactive validation; uses system webviews, no Electron.

evidence.title: Project board
evidence.finding: Four durable stages Pending, In progress, Review, Settled; tasks saved without starting an agent; comments panel; no archive; settling implies no commit or merge.

evidence.title: Worktrees
evidence.locator: Creating a worktree, Cleaning up, Native behavior
evidence.finding: Per-task git worktree beside the project on a pandacode/<name> branch; removal guarded; git worktree add/remove run with argument arrays.

evidence.title: GitHub
evidence.locator: GitHub view, Importing issues, Linked work, Pull requests
evidence.finding: Uses gh CLI only; GitHub view with threads, PRs, issues; one-shot issue import to Pending tasks; push and open pull request; no background sync; one issue and one PR linked per task.

evidence.title: Task schedules
evidence.finding: Native scheduler with once, interval, daily, weekly and after-task triggers; agent tools to schedule wake-ups; clock loop ticks every 15 s inside the app; paused setting; three consecutive failures disable a schedule.

evidence.title: Approval behaviours
evidence.locator: Mode table, Full access mappings, Plan mode
evidence.finding: Per-task permission modes (Standard, Accept edits, Approve for me, Plan, Full access) mapped to each harness native flags; new tasks start in Full access; Pi enforced through a PandaCode extension.

evidence.title: Cloud agents
evidence.locator: How it works, State, Provider settings, Privacy
evidence.finding: Tasks can run on machines in the user own account at 20 cloud providers; checkout sent as git bundle; run detached under a runner and re-attached after sleep or quit; supported harnesses claude, glm, mimo, codex, opencode.

evidence.title: Remote access (PandaCode Connect)
evidence.locator: Pieces, Mirrors, Accounts, Limits (free), End-to-end encryption, Privacy
evidence.finding: Opt-in GitHub device-flow sign-in; Cloudflare Worker relay forwards end-to-end encrypted frames; tasks run on another signed-in computer or a headless host; limits are 10 devices per account.

evidence.title: Machine orchestration
evidence.finding: Off by default; agents can link, launch, message, wait on, read and stop threads on the user other computers with per-machine access levels read, ask and full.

evidence.title: Headless server
evidence.locator: What the server runs, First run, Linux server
evidence.finding: pandacode serve runs the same binary without a window as a Connect host; needs a display (xvfb) on Linux; secrets stored in a 0600 file; no updater.

evidence.title: Architect and workers
evidence.finding: Architect delegates assignments to workers across 21 harnesses; workers run full access in parallel; worker list, retained histories, corrections, model routing, stall watchdog.

evidence.title: Changes after a turn
evidence.finding: Attributed per-turn file change summaries with immutable saved patches in SQLite; limits on paths, bytes and retention.

evidence.title: Agent usage panel
evidence.locator: Estimated API cost, Sources and tradeoffs
evidence.finding: Account limit meters per harness and estimated API cost from Claude Code and Codex logs priced from the LiteLLM list; other harnesses show Cost not tracked.

evidence.finding: Harness list, sign-in paths, named connections, account pools for Claude Code and Codex, harness switch with conversation transfer, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

evidence.title: Agent tools and integrations
evidence.finding: pandacode_* app tools for task discovery, create, start, follow up, steer, board stages, worktrees, browser and code search; approval boundary for host tools.

evidence.title: Settings
evidence.finding: Settings sections incl. Schedules, Tools, Connections; project checks after turns run the npm test script or cargo check with a two-minute limit.

evidence.title: PandaCode mobile
evidence.finding: Expo app for iOS and Android that views and controls tasks on computers through Connect; the phone never runs tasks; build from source.

evidence.title: Bots
evidence.finding: Persistent named agents reachable from the desktop, a local web chat, Telegram, Slack, Discord and WhatsApp with schedules, memory, approval rules and an activity log.

evidence.title: Goals and harness command workflows
evidence.finding: Codex /goal with token budget and a shared four-agent concurrency limit; harness slash commands.

evidence.title: Edit and rewind a sent prompt
evidence.finding: Edit forks the conversation before a message into a new task; files are not rewound.

evidence.title: Run and preview
evidence.finding: Run button starts the checkout pandacode-run.sh in a managed terminal tab and opens a preview.

evidence.title: Crash recovery
evidence.finding: Guard process restarts the app after a crash; interrupted agents are marked Interrupted; reports stay local; drafts kept as plain text for up to 30 days.

evidence.title: Skill manager
evidence.finding: Lists skills installed for any harness, switches them per project or globally, adds skills from skills.sh, GitHub, GitLab or a folder.

evidence.title: Capabilities
evidence.finding: Read-only inventory of slash commands, MCP server names, hooks, plugin names and skills across harnesses; does not activate integrations.

evidence.title: Model routing
evidence.finding: Local Panda Router (MIT) picks a worker model in about 10-25 ms with no task data leaving the machine.

evidence.title: Workflow recipes
evidence.finding: JSON recipes of prompt, slash, check and approval steps stored per project or globally.

evidence.title: PandaCode Connect relay
evidence.finding: Cloudflare Worker with a Durable Object per account; deploy steps with a GitHub OAuth app; stores no task content; push payloads carry counts and a deep link only.

evidence.title: CI workflow
evidence.finding: CI runs typecheck and build, node tests, release tests, website build, cargo test and clippy with warnings denied, and a Panda Router parity check on macOS.
